reference: Written by scripts/generate-wizardconnect-sign-in-proof-vectors.mts with @bitauth/libauth 3.1.0-next.8 alone; nothing here comes from the wallet. Every signed proof was accepted by the libauth BCH VM under consensus rules, and `standard` records whether its relay-policy VM accepts it too. Each request is in the shape crates/optn-core/src/sign_in_proof.rs takes and each reason is what that module must answer. Keys come from the public BIP39 test mnemonic; never a wallet or network credential.

wallet.mnemonic: abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about
